job.job_title: AI Backend Engineer | Python | FastAPI | LLM | RAG
job.job_description:
Work Type: Work from Office Mandatory, Monday to Friday
Work Timing: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Work Location: Chennai Ramanujam IT Tech Park, Thiruvanmiyur and/or Client Office Premises
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners preferred; maximum 30 days
Experience: 8-12 Years



Role:

We are looking for an experienced Backend / AI Engineer with strong expertise in Python-based backend development and hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM integration, RAG, and AI application development.




Must Have:

Strong experience in Python and Fast API
REST API design and development
Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL
GenAI / LLM API integration
Experience implementing RAG solutions
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
Basic prompt engineering / prompt design
Strong development experience using Git
Experience in developing scalable backend applications



Good to Have:

Experience with Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Search
Application development on AWS or Azure
Hands-on experience with Docker
Experience in AI Agent / Multi-Agent development
Asynchronous processing and streaming
Experience with AI application deployment and integration



Ability to Learn & Adopt:

Evaluation, logging, monitoring, and tracing of AI applications
AI Ops and identification of accuracy degradation or abnormal AI behaviour
Understanding of AI security, authorization, and access control
AI application cost monitoring and optimization
Ability to quickly learn and adopt new AI/Cloud technologies
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills



Key Responsibilities:

Design and develop scalable backend services using Python/Fast API.
Build and integrate GenAI/LLM-powered applications.
Develop RAG-based solutions and AI-driven workflows.
Design and integrate REST APIs and databases.
Develop AI Agents and Multi-Agent solutions where required.
Implement logging, monitoring, evaluation, and tracing for AI applications.
Ensure application security, authorization, performance, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with technical teams and client stakeholders to deliver AI solutions.



Preferred Candidate

A strong Backend / AI Engineer who combines solid software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, Cloud, and AI application development, and is comfortable working in a client-facing, work-from-office environment.
